'''Hellhounds''' are monsters found in [[Doom RPG]] (a member of the [[Canine]] class) and [[Doom Eternal]] (as a creature summoned by [[Marauder]]s).
==Background==
===Doom RPG===
The Hellhound is a monster found in [[Doom RPG]] belonging to a demonic class known as [[Canine]]s. Hellhounds are brown members of the species. They can be captured with dog collars to become a trained attack dog.

===Doom 3===
[[File:PinkyD3G2.png|thumb]]
The [[Demon/Doom 3|Pinkies]] in Doom 3 are also referred to as 'hellhounds'.
===Doom Eternal===
The [[Marauder]] will occasionally summon an orange spectral [[Summoned Wolf|Hellhound]], which chases you and delivers biting damage. While more of a nuisance than a threat, damage from the Hellhound can add up quickly and distract you from the fight at hand.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Doom_64_Hellhound.jpg|thumb|A sculpture of the Hellhound by Gregor Punchatz.]]
The Hellhound is a monster intended to appear in ''[[Doom 64]]'', and sadly, it didn't make it to the final cut. Its existing sculpture is that of a demonic canine with two heads, resembling the Greek mythogical [[Wikipedia:Orthrus|Orthrus]].
